text: The interim Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority considered Item PA8.4, "Matters Arising from Ongoing Reviews of Delivery of Security Services", at its March 5, 2018 meeting. The Board, among other things, directed the Acting President to request the City of Toronto's Director of Corporate Security to conduct a comprehensive assessment of Toronto Parking Authority security strategies, plans, and deployment, covering all aspects the Director considers appropriate (the "Security Services Assessment"). This Security Services Assessment is nearing completion, with a number of findings currently available. The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Confirmed its actions in closed session in issuing instructions to staff. 2. Expressed the Toronto Parking Authority's appreciation for the comprehensive work and efforts, to date, of the City of Toronto's Director of Corporate Security and associated staff with respect to the Security Services Assessment. 3. Directed the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, in consultation with the Director, Corporate Security, to develop a Toronto Parking Authority Security Plan and any related policies, consistent with Item GM22.4, City-Wide Security Plan, adopted by City Council at its April 29 and 30, 2009 meeting, and directed that such Plan and policies be submitted to the Board for consideration by the end of second quarter, 2019. 4.
